description: Defines a sealed class 'SyncStatus' representing various synchronization states for UI and diagnostics, including Idle, Running, Success, and Error.

classes.name: SyncStatus
classes.description: A sealed class representing different synchronization states for the app, including idle, running, successful completion, and error states.

methods.name: SyncStatus.Idle
methods.description: Represents the state when synchronization is idle.

methods.name: SyncStatus.Running
methods.description: Represents the state when synchronization is currently running.

methods.name: SyncStatus.Success
methods.description: Represents a successful sync completion with the timestamp of completion.

methods.name: SyncStatus.Error
methods.description: Represents an error state during synchronization with an associated error message.
